item.title: Trump threatens Canada with 100% tariff over pending trade deal with China
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Saturday he would impose a 100% tariff on Canada if it follows through on a trade deal with China and warned Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney that a deal would endanger his country. MORE..

item.title: Suspect arrested with micro pistol and ammunition in Ambalangoda
item.description: A suspect has been arrested after a micro pistol and live ammunition was found concealed inside a room of a residence in the Wathugedara area of Ambalangoda. MORE..

item.title: 250 Health and Wellness Centres to be established islandwide – Health Minister
item.description: Minister of Health and Mass Media, Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa, says steps will be taken to establish 250 Health and Wellness Centres across the country to strengthen preventive healthcare services. MORE..

item.title: Sri Lankan arrested with over 8 kg of Kush at BIA
item.description: A Sri Lankan has been arrested at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) for attempting to smuggle a consignment of Kush cannabis with an estimated street value of Rs. 82.2 million, into the country. MORE..

item.title: Over 280 kg of drugs worth Rs. 4.5 bln recovered from intercepted fishing trawlers
item.description: The two multi-day fishing trawlers and the 11 suspects taken into custody in deep seas off the southern coast and brought to the Dikkowita Fisheries Harbour have undergone further inspection, where the seized narcotics were weighed. MORE..

item.title: Three arrested at BIA for attempting to smuggle Kush and Hashish
item.description: Three passengers attempting to smuggle a consignment of “Kush” and “Hashish” valued at Rs. 133.94 million into the country have been arrested at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) by Airport Customs officers and a group of officers of Customs Narcotics Control Unit. MORE..

item.title: US storm leaves 160,000 without power, forces thousands of flight cancellations
item.description: More than 4,000 flights were canceled in the U.S. on Saturday ahead of a monster winter storm that has already cut power to more than 160,000 electricity customers as far west as Texas, and threatened to paralyze eastern states with heavy snowfall. MORE..

item.title: Govt to launch digital platform to guide village-level development projects
item.description: The government has decided to introduce a new digital system to strengthen planning and oversight of village-level development projects under Prajashakthi National Movement , the President s Media Division (PMD) said in a statement. MORE..

item.title: Russian national drowns while swimming at Bentota Beach
item.description: A Russian woman has died after drowning while swimming at Bentota Beach. MORE..

item.title: Large number of local and foreign tourists visit Nuwara Eliya amid record low temperatures
item.description: A large number of local and foreign tourists have visited Nuwara Eliya during the weekend holiday. MORE..
